Limit[n=10]
  Sort[keys=o.total_price DESC]
    Project[o.id AS order_id, c.name AS cust_name, c.nation AS nation, o.total_price AS total_price, o.order_date AS order_date]
      Filter[c.nation = 'UNITED STATES' AND o.total_price > 1000.0]
        Join[kind=inner, cond=o.cust_id = c.id]
          Scan[orders]
          Scan[customer]
